title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode6 The Sports Festival Begins!

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The Kamiyama High School Sports Festival has begun! Our opening event is turning into a heated battle for first place between the red and blue teams!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Nicely done, Akito.
Your speed should guarantee you first place.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line: Dude, why are you cheering for the red team?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Li'l Bro's way too fast...!
I can't close this gap!)

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome from the red team's got his assignment! Everyone, can you guess what it says?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Okay, just gotta find what's written on here and run back with it...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Shinonome seems a bit flustered.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki, go catch up to him!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's the matter, Akito?!
Why are you all frozen up?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(“Someone with a very loud voice.”
That means... No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akito, what does it say?!
If there's anything I can do, just ask!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Geez, how loud can someone be?
I can hear them from all the way over here. They're not even using a mic.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, what's going on with Akito?
He seems really bothered for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
A little late... But I finally caught up...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Did Li'l Bro draw a really bad assignment or something?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope I get something easy... Please!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Someone!
I need an accessory with a ribbon motif!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh!
The bracelet I wore for today...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that should be fairly easy to find.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Does anyone nearby have anything like that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Take this! I wore it here today!
It should be what you're looking for!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here! Hurry or Akito's gonna catch up to you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Grr...!
Why'd you have to go and do that, Ena...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
No way I'm losing to the red team!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Looks like I don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so you do need my help after all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, what can I do for you?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Awesome! The goal's right there!
At this rate, I should finish first and...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
But my lead was huge! He already caught up?!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Tenma's riding piggyback on Shinonome! Looks like it's full steam ahead!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
We're cruising past everyone!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know! Please, just be quiet for a bit...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He can run this fast while carrying someone...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But... I'm not ready to lose just yet!!)

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
What's this?!
Akiyama's found another gear!
Can Shinonome close the gap?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Catch me if you can!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The wind's starting to dry out my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Looks like Shinonome's also found another gear! Talk about speed!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
This race just keeps giving!
Akiyama tripped while trying to see where Shinonome is!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No...
I'm still not giving up!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
Akiyama's back up!
Shinonome flies by!
He's back in the lead!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
And there you have it!
With the crowd roaring in the background...

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
Akiyama finishes second!
What an incredible race!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I was sooo close!
Next time, you're going down!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So close!
You did great, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just glad Mizuki didn't get hurt too bad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, Shinonome has some quick legs on him...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He does help out with the soccer club a lot. Also, you need a ton of stamina to get through our practices.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That means Aoyagi may also pull off something special since he's also on your team.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiraishi, won't you be facing him next during the ball toss?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But our practices have been good training for me too, so I'm not letting him walk away with this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of battle unfolds.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Alright, the mixed ball toss is usually a drama-filled event each year, and it looks like the green team's having a bit of a tough go at it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Nice, Shiraishi.
Your form's as good as a baseball player's.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hold on. You've been watching me this whole time. Shouldn't you be helping the green team not finish last...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We'll need to work more efficiently to overcome this deficit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone on the green team. Listen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suspect that this ball toss event favors taller people.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not the most agile person, but I think I can help throw these balls into that basket.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I'd like it if you could gather up these balls and bring them to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Classmate
rows.Line:
That's fine and all...
But isn't this the first ball toss event you've ever been in, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That won't be an issue.
I have a good idea of what to do after watching Shiraishi throw these.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What...?!
That's why you were staring at me?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
It actually might be better if you threw them instead of me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on. I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Ah, I see...
It seemed odd that Aoyagi wasn't doing much of anything. I guess he had a plan in his back pocket this entire time.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, here you go.
I got you some balls.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This should be more than plenty.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Oh no...!
If Toya gets serious now, he might...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hmm... That's strange.
My body may've gone off-axis.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'll get this next one to...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, I seem to have run out.
Would you mind gathering some more for me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean, sure...
But it might be faster for us to just throw them, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Great work during the events, everyone! We will now be announcing how things currently stand.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Following that, it'll be time for Kamiyama High School's famed cheering competition. We will be passing out voting slips to everybody watching, so please make sure you get one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We're already halfway through. That was fast.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The standings may change how we all feel going into the cheering competition... Alright, let's see them...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Whoa! It's almost time for the cheering competition! I'm getting super-duper excited☆>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hey, you shouldn't jump out like that. What if someone sees you?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sorry!
I can't wait to see the cheering competition because Rui worked so hard on it!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I promise to do what I can to meet your expectations.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But before I do, I'll need to hear what the current standings are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, right!
How do you think the blue team's doing, Rui?>

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
Okay...
We've just tallied up the score.
